counterexamples.evidence: Runs 0 and 2 emit [zone:col7]book move[/zone:col7] / "play the book move" and never write the digit 7 in prose, though the assembled prompt line 3 reads "- Better move: column 7 (lands at c7r2). Outcome: win." The zone handle let the model point at the column without naming it, so a player reading the served text alone is never told which column to play.

Run 3 omits both required single-square handles and names no square at all; its whole causal claim is "you let your opponent answer in a way that takes away that late resource". The board shows the located version is available: on opponentPunishment.finalMovestring 3332222652 the opponent plays column 3 and occupies c3r5, killing the row-5 four c3r5-c6r5 that completes at c6r5 on move 41 of 33322226664420600000211111313344445556655.
